task.description: WF-03 Step 4b REWORK ITERATION 1 REGATE -- hard gate on TEST-DESIGNER's new regression tests for the check.test.ex fix. On branch feature/WF03-ISS0699-20260917. TEST-DESIGNER added two new tests to test/mix/tasks/letflow_check_test_test.exs (an env-var-passthrough test and a log-dir-cleanup-after-clean-run test) plus an install_env_var_aware_fake_bash/2 helper, and reported a fail-then-pass proof (15/17 passing with 2 new failures against a pre-rework-1 scratch copy of lib/mix/tasks/letflow.check.test.ex, 17/17 against current). Independently read the new tests yourself and INDEPENDENTLY REPRODUCE the fail-then-pass claim -- do not accept the report without reproducing it: (1) run `mix test test/mix/tasks/letflow_check_test_test.exs` against the current branch (should be 17/17 passing), (2) construct your own pre-rework-1 scratch copy (e.g. `git show 0b02f6d9:lib/mix/tasks/letflow.check.test.ex` swapped in temporarily, restored afterward -- verify with git status --porcelain that you left the tree clean) and confirm the same 2 tests FAIL there. Verify the fake-bash helper genuinely tests the Port.open :env passthrough mechanism (not a hand-simulated stand-in that could pass regardless of whether the real env var reaches the subprocess). Claim by flipping status to IN_PROGRESS on receipt, and set it to COMPLETED/FAILED as normal when you finish.
acceptance_criteria: PASS only if you independently reproduced the fail-then-pass result yourself (quote your own run output)
PASS only if the fake-bash mechanism genuinely tests the real :env passthrough, not a mechanism that would pass even if the passthrough were broken
PASS only if you verified test/scripts/test_parallel_tmpdir_cleanup_test.sh (iteration 0) is untouched and still passes
PASS only if the working tree is confirmed clean (git status --porcelain empty) after your own scratch-copy verification

result.summary: Independently reproduced, not trusted from the report. (1) `mix test test/mix/tasks/letflow_check_test_test.exs` on current branch: 'Finished in 3.5 seconds (0.00s async, 3.5s sync)\nResult: 17 passed' -- 17/17, matches claim. (2) Built my own pre-rework-1 scratch copy via `git show 0b02f6d9:lib/mix/tasks/letflow.check.test.ex > lib/mix/tasks/letflow.check.test.ex` (0b02f6d9 = the commit immediately preceding ISS-0699's tmp_dir-cleanup fix ffc7bd1c), reran the same suite: 'Finished in 3.3 seconds (0.00s async, 3.3s sync)\nResult: 15/17 passed'. The 2 failures were exactly the 2 new tests: '1) ... the partition-log directory is removed after a clean run's own successful read ... Expected false or nil, got true / code: refute File.exists?(log_dir)' and '2) ... TEST_PARALLEL_KEEP_LOGS=1 set on run_main_suite/0's own bash invocation reaches the subprocess's own environment ... (Mix.Error) mix letflow.check.test: FAILED -- scripts/test_parallel.sh exited 1 before ever printing its partition-log-directory line'. Both failures are for the right reason (no env passthrough, no cleanup) -- matches TEST-DESIGNER's fail-then-pass claim exactly. Restored via `git checkout -- lib/mix/tasks/letflow.check.test.ex`; confirmed `git status --porcelain` empty and `diff` against a pre-edit backup copy showed the restored file byte-identical. Mechanism check: install_env_var_aware_fake_bash/2 (test/mix/tasks/letflow_check_test_test.exs lines 747-807) branches its own behavior on `[ -n "${TEST_PARALLEL_KEEP_LOGS:-}" ]` (POSIX) / `if defined TEST_PARALLEL_KEEP_LOGS` (Windows .bat) evaluated INSIDE the fake subprocess's own environment -- it cannot pass unless Erlang's Port.open :env option genuinely delivered the var across the process boundary; my own pre-fix reproduction above independently confirms this, since removing the :env passthrough code made exactly this test fail with the fake bash's 'unset' branch (exit 1, no log-dir line) rather than a hand-simulated stand-in that would pass regardless. test/scripts/test_parallel_tmpdir_cleanup_test.sh (iteration 0): `git log` shows its only commit is ec312700 (unchanged since, `git diff HEAD` empty); ran it directly: 'PASS: clean exit, KEEP_LOGS unset -> tmp_dir removed' / 'PASS: clean exit, KEEP_LOGS set -> tmp_dir preserved' / 'PASS: failing exit, KEEP_LOGS unset -> tmp_dir preserved' / 'PASS: failing exit, KEEP_LOGS set -> tmp_dir preserved' / 'test_parallel_tmpdir_cleanup_test: 4 passed, 0 failed', exit code 0 -- untouched and still passing. Working tree confirmed clean throughout (git status --porcelain empty both before and after the scratch-copy swap).
